messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired: queue_ingress_backlog (severity: high). Service: inference-router-prod. Autoscale controller heartbeat missing for ~2m. Current queue depth: 1,220. Pager: @oncall-alex
oncall-alex: Ack. I'm on call, checking controller and nodes now.
pagerduty: PagerDuty: Incident acknowledged by oncall-alex.
support-lin: FYI seeing customer 504/timeout reports, 503s up ~2.3% over 5m window.
sre-jas: Copy. Grafana: https://grafana.redwood.aws/d/abc123/queue-metrics (queue depth panel) — nodes metric shows scale-controller heartbeat gap.
eng-ryan: If controller lost leader lease it could stop scaling. Quick check: `kubectl get pods -n inference | grep scale-controller`
oncall-alex: Running check... scale-controller-5f7c9 CrashLoopBackOff x2
oncall-alex: `kubectl logs scale-controller-5f7c9 -n inference` -> "failed to renew lease: operation timed out"
ops-maya: Suggest immediate mitigation: manual scale to buy time. Can someone run `kubectl scale deployment inference-cell --replicas=10 -n inference`?
oncall-alex: Doing that now. `kubectl scale` -> deployment.apps/inference-cell scaled
incident-bot: Automated action: routing policy enabled fallback to dedicated pool (low-priority tenants) to reduce ingress pressure.
eng-ryan: Also seeing provider-side capacity errors in cloud logs: "InsufficientInstanceCapacity" for g4dn requests. I'm opening infra ticket with cloud provider.
sre-jas: Kicking off manual node provisioning script to add spot-backed nodes; ETA ~3-6m.
oncall-alex: Queue depth dropping to 360, request latency trending down. Continuing to watch.
support-lin: Noted. Logged one enterprise customer (acct: AcmeCorp) impact; no data loss reported, will follow up.
oncall-alex: For follow-up, disabling autoscaler until we patch lease renewal. Recommend RBAC and leader-election TTL review.
eng-ryan: Filed GH issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/eng-runtime/issues/4825 — assigned to @eng-runtime. Added logs and reproduction notes.
sre-jas: Will draft post-incident notes if we escalate. For now confirm mitigation and timeline.
pagerduty: PagerDuty: Incident marked mitigated by oncall-alex. Please continue monitoring and update if regressions occur.
